title: The Payment Forms for Paystack WordPress plugin before 4.0.6 does not properly restrict access to a page that displays…
description: The Payment Forms for Paystack WordPress plugin versions before 4.0.6 improperly restrict access to a configuration page. This flaw allows users with the Contributor role and above to view sensitive payment gateway API credentials, including live and test secret keys, which provide full access to the site owner's payment account.
